Crate Label Guidance for Safe Pet Travel

This guide helps you prepare labels and documents so your animal can move through the airport with care. The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways welcomes questions in a warm, practical tone, and our aim is to reduce handling errors before they happen.

Use a clean crate label that is easy to read and securely attached to the carrier. Include the traveler's name, the animal's name, and a reachable contact line. Keep the label simple, since crowded writing can be missed during a busy handoff. If you are traveling with Thor or another calm companion, check that the label still stays visible after the crate is secured.

Before departure, look over the crate for loose ties, damaged latches, or anything that could snag. A ground team moves carriers carefully between services, but a sturdy crate still helps protect the animal during transfer. Add any required feeding notes or care instructions in plain language, and avoid folding paper where it may hide important details.

If your pet needs special attention, tell the desk early so the team can prepare the right support. <<FACT F002>> Place any comfort items only if they fit safely inside the carrier and do not block air flow. Fresh water should be provided in the approved container, and bedding should remain dry and clean.

A final check before you leave can prevent delays and confusion. Make sure the label matches the travel papers, the carrier closes properly, and your contact details are easy to confirm at a glance. If you need more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways for patient, practical support.
